title: New announce integration tests leak temp dirs when an assertion fails
description: Found by robustness review of project-LICHEN-worker6-dowx. remove_roots in announce.rs tests (unique_test_roots/remove_roots helpers, ~1074-1077) runs only at the end of each happy path; on assertion failure the pid-suffixed dirs under std::env::temp_dir() leak (<=2 dirs per test, <=6 total). Bounded and acceptable in the short term. Fix with a guard struct whose Drop removes the roots.
